result.label: "ay" in Faraday (name fragment)
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ay' completing "Faraday" (ad|ay), as in Faraday's law/experiments, in electromagnetic-induction context. It is driven by detection of the preceding 'ad' fragment. Output logits are mixed.

minimal_pairs.text: Faraday's law describes how a changing magnetic flux induces an EMF.
Michael Faraday's experiments on electromagnetic induction were groundbreaking.
Michael Faraz's experiments on electromagnetic induction were groundbreaking.
The bay was calm and the ferry left on time.

result.label: ' make' in 'makeup' compound
result.description: Fires on ' make' (mostly in "genetic make|up") where the word continues as a compound like makeup. Other make/made forms elsewhere (make sure) are weaker. Pushes suffixes such as 'up', 'ups', 'over'.

minimal_pairs.text: Our genetic makeup is shaped by inherited mutations.
Scientists study the genetic makeup of marine organisms.
Please make sure the door is locked before you leave.
Our genetic code is shaped by inherited mutations.

result.label: Era-prefix fragments Pale-, Mes-, Ne-
result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' Pale', ' Mes', ' Ne' that begin geological or archaeological era names (Paleolithic, Mesozoic, Neolithic). Pushes continuations like 'ol', 'oz', 'olit'.

minimal_pairs.text: Stone tools were common during the Paleolithic period.
Dinosaurs flourished in the Mesozoic era.
Stone tools were common during the old period.
Dinosaurs flourished in the late era.

result.label: Sentence-final period in cooking text
result.description: Fires on sentence-ending periods (occasionally colons) in culinary/meat-cooking prose, especially at the end of a segment before a new section. Period detectors combine with cooking-context members; output logits are not coherent.

ingredients.role: period at end of segment, predicts 'This/The'

minimal_pairs.text: Searing locks in flavor and keeps the meat tender. Next, rest the steak.
Marinating: enhancing flavor and tenderness of the cut before grilling.
The committee approved the budget for the new bridge. Construction starts in May.
Searing locks in flavor and keeps the meat tender, then rest the steak

result.label: ' rather' before 'than'
result.description: Fires on the word " rather" (also "Rather" at sentence start) in "X rather than Y" contrasts. Upstream members are all detectors of " rather". Output pushes " than".

minimal_pairs.text: She chose to listen, rather than argue with him.
Focus on the problem rather than the person.
She chose to listen, instead of arguing with him.
The soup was rather salty, but I liked it.

result.label: BI acronym after Business Intelligence
result.description: Fires on the token 'BI' in the acronym "Business Intelligence (BI)", in the slot where an acronym follows its expanded term. Members detect 'B', 'intelligence', and IT/business acronym contexts. The output logits are not coherent.

ingredients.role: detects 'B' fragment, switches off on contrast

minimal_pairs.text: Business Intelligence (BI) systems help companies analyze past data.
Our team adopted Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards to track sales.
Emotional Intelligence (EI) systems help people analyze feelings.
Our team adopted dashboards to track sales and business insights.

result.label: social protection/welfare policy nouns
result.description: Fires on 'protection', 'safety', 'security' and the 'are' of 'welfare' when they follow 'social' or welfare-policy context. It pushes next words like schemes, measures, programs and policies.

minimal_pairs.text: Social protection measures are essential for vulnerable households.
Modern states fund social welfare programs to support the poor.
The museum offers protection for the paintings from sunlight.
Contract law and antitrust law are taught in the second year.

result.label: ' both' after copula
result.description: Fires on the word "both" (usually after "can be", "is", "are", "serving as") where it starts a paired description, e.g. "both X and Y". Predicts adjectives or noun phrases such as "an", "a", "celebrated".

minimal_pairs.text: Good teachers can be both demanding and kind.
The new policy is both practical and popular.
Good teachers can be demanding and kind.
She chose a friend rather than an acquaintance.

result.label: Second 'as' in 'as ADJ as'
result.description: Fires on the second 'as' of an equative comparison ('as important to X as it is...'), after the adjective and complement. The circuit is built from 'as' detectors that predict 'it/they/possible'.

minimal_pairs.text: The presentation of a dish is as important to chefs as it is to diners.
A dancer must be as adaptable as a chameleon.
The presentation of a dish is important to chefs, as it is to diners.
She works as a chef in a small restaurant.

result.label: 'ic' in music-therapy context
result.description: Fires mostly on the suffix 'ic' of "therapeutic" (also ' its', ' and') in passages about music and therapy. Members are music/therapy/brain context detectors, not token detectors. Logits are incoherent.

minimal_pairs.text: Music therapy is a highly immersive therapeutic approach that helps clients relax.
Musicians can access and utilize the therapeutic effects of their instruments.
The car has a fantastic engine and a systematic approach to manufacturing.
The therapists may incorporate different approaches to create customized interventions.

result.label: multi-/tri- numeric prefixes
result.description: Fires on word-initial numeric prefixes ' multi', 'multi', ' Multi' and ' tri' before the word continues (multiplayer, multiples, triangles, trials). Output pushes completions like plex, ples, part, player.

minimal_pairs.text: The game supports multiplayer modes and multi-user servers.
Students studied the properties of triangles in geometry.
The game supports online modes and shared servers.
Students studied the properties of shapes in geometry.

result.label: Acid-base chemistry word starts
result.description: Fires on varied tokens (' pro' of proton, ' p' of pH, ' acid', ' dis' of dissociate) in passages on acids, bases and dissociation. Pushes next tokens like acid, base, weak, buffer.

ingredients.role: detects 'bases' in weak acids and bases

minimal_pairs.text: A strong acid readily donates a proton to water.
The concentration of any acid on the pH scale indicates acidity.
The chef donates a portion of the soup to the shelter.
The sets are balanced separately to balance the complete molecule into its parent.

result.label: Possessive 's after scientist names
result.description: Fires on the possessive 's after a name or noun (Gauss's, Ampère's, Euler's), especially in physics/math contexts. It pushes toward named-law words such as Law, Equations, Theorem.

minimal_pairs.text: The magnetic field obeys Ampère's circuital law.
Gauss's law relates electric flux to charge.
The magnetic field obeys the circuital law of Ampère.
Maxwell equations describe electromagnetism in detail.

result.label: 'iv' piece in 'pivotal'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'iv' in "pivotal" (p|iv|otal), mostly after "is/are". It also fires weakly on other 'iv' fragments (carnivory, omnivores). Output pushes the continuation 'otal'.

minimal_pairs.text: Early feedback is pivotal in shaping how students learn.
This decision marked a pivotal moment for the company.
Early feedback is essential in shaping how students learn.
This decision marked a crucial moment for the company.
